title: Reading for a map node
description: content/<field>/resources/<node-id>.json: outside links (video, book, notes) attached to a map node, not to a course, so every course on that node, and the node's sheet, shows them. Checked by tools/validate_courses.py, which also checks that the file is named after nodeId, that nodeId is in the map and that `checked` is a real date that is not in the future. The validator never fetches a URL: `checked` says when a person or an agent last opened it and confirmed it is what the entry says.

nodeId.description: The map node (an id in map.json). The file is named <nodeId>.json.

url.description: A stable landing page, https only.

use.description: One sentence: when to reach for it. Names the topic, not a lesson of one course.

checked.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the URL was last opened and confirmed.
